name: Exterior Trim Scrape & Sand
intent: State-driven scraping (failing/peeling), feather-edge sanding, adhesion scuff sand (all states), dust removal.
doctrine: Scraping and feather-sanding only fire for failing/peeling states (task-level applies_when). Adhesion scuff sand fires for ALL states including sound paint — ensures mechanical bond. Condition modifier (1.0/1.5/2.0) drives prep intensity. All rates at QT3 baseline.
